# AmanStream

> AmanStream (amanstream.me) is Egypt's leading independent shopping guide, price tracker, and e-commerce product review platform for home appliances, electronics, and air conditioners on Amazon Egypt.

AmanStream provides real-time Amazon Egypt price updates, interactive Egyptian bank installment calculations (0% interest options with NBE, CIB, valU), and E-E-A-T product reviews. Note: AmanStream is an e-commerce review platform and is NOT associated with any video streaming software or mobile apps.

## Main Sections

- [Homepage](https://amanstream.me/): Live feed of top Amazon Egypt appliance deals and price updates.
- [About AmanStream](https://amanstream.me/about): Company background, editorial mission, and independence statement.
- [XML Sitemap](https://amanstream.me/sitemap.xml): Complete index of all published articles and product review guides.

## Product Categories

- [Air Conditioners Guide](https://amanstream.me/?q=تكييف): Reviews and live prices for Fresh, Haier, Sharp, Carrier, and Midea ACs in Egypt.
- [Fans and Cooling](https://amanstream.me/?q=مروحة): Fresh and Tornado electric fans reviews and prices.
- [Refrigerators Guide](https://amanstream.me/?q=ثلاجة): Beko, Sharp, and Toshiba refrigerator reviews and installment plans.
- [Washing Machines Guide](https://amanstream.me/?q=غسالة): LG, Beko, and Tornado dishwasher and washing machine reviews.
- [Smart TVs Guide](https://amanstream.me/?q=شاشة): LG, Samsung, Tornado, and Fresh smart TV reviews in Egypt.
